definition: the daughter of your brother or sister
description: A long family lunch outdoors under a vine-covered pergola by an old stone house on a sunny day. A bald older man in a light blue shirt leans over and pulls a coin from behind the ear of a young woman in a green sundress, who covers her eyes and laughs, holding a fork with a peach slice. He holds up the coin and she points at it, laughing. A grey-haired woman next to her laughs too. The linen table is full of grilled vegetables, peaches, bread and water carafes.

en.question: What is the bald man doing?

de.answer: Er zieht eine Münze hinter ihrem Ohr hervor.
